en: A colorized vintage view over a river running through a European city, with promenades and streets lined with trees and historic buildings. In the background, on a hill, stands a fortified complex and a prominent clock tower. In the foreground, people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the riverside and ride in horse‑drawn carriages. At the top left of the image appears the caption 'Graz mit Schlossberg'.
